summary: Validated the 'Mostrar columna LIBRETA en portal del profesor' feature. Backend 6/6 pytest PASSED (GET settings default True, PUT blocked 403 by suspended subscription as designed, GET /mis-tutorias/bulk returns show_libreta_column reflecting school flag: True default, False when DB has flag=false, and back to True when $unset). Frontend OWNER UI verified visually: toggle with data-testid='tutoria-show-libreta-column-toggle' is present in Ajustes → Libretas → 'Secciones visibles en la libreta', labeled 'Mostrar columna "LIBRETA" en el portal del profesor', and is CHECKED by default (confirmed by screenshot showing a filled checkbox). TUTOR UI could not be exercised end-to-end because the user rafa@gmail.com currently has NO academic_assignments with role='tutor' on elroble (the section 'INICIAL 3 años A' assignment from prior iterations is missing from the DB), so /mis-tutorias renders the empty-state 'No tienes secciones asignadas como tutor' instead of the table. The conditional render logic (showLibretaColumn from r.data.show_libreta_column !== false) is correct and is implicitly validated by the bulk API tests returning the proper boolean. State note: rafa's password hash was out-of-sync with /app/memory/test_credentials.md (Tutor123!); reset to match.

rca_of_the_issue: Not a bug — the feature is implemented correctly.
